Experiment 1 reports 600-token source chunks, 100-token overlap and 8k-token summary/answer contexts. Their original-run correspondence is unaudited; no experiment-specific configuration, selected level or seed is assigned to this generic workflow.
Code implementation, original experiments, tie ordering, all-zero answers and oversize-item handling were not verified.
Method-defined counts or scores do not establish factual correctness. This paper is a general text-sensemaking preprint; medical validation is outside its tested scope here.

Source study evaluation is separate and explicitly undrawn. V2 contains sections 3.2 and 3.3 followed by section 4; there is no section 3.4. Later claim-count/cluster-count procedures are not executed or diagrammed here.

Minor reviewer presentation observations are retained; complete caption must accompany diagram. No target journal-size pass, cross-platform replay, external-editor roundtrip, original model run or clinical validation.
Native assertion counts and byte comparisons are not independent scientific trials. Replayed accepted bytes reuse original native/visual acceptance rather than create a second native trial.
